title: GitHub Trending Repos - Hot Today
description: Scrapes github.com/trending (daily + weekly) for the repositories trending on GitHub right now, ranked by stars gained. GitHub has never offered an official trending API, so this reads the public trending page; if the markup ever changes it falls back to the official Search API (recently-created repos by stars). Every row in a run shares one _epoch so a downstream saved search can surface only repos appearing for the FIRST time (no-repeat dedup). No auth. Powers the 'GitHub Hot Repos' daily alert group.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# github_trending_repos -- Slice B (2026-06-23).
# Scrapes github.com/trending (daily + weekly) for the "hot repos" feed.
# GitHub has never offered an official trending API, so we scrape the HTML.
# Hybrid fallback: if the page markup ever changes and scraping yields too
# few rows, fall back to the official Search API (recently-created repos by
# stars). Every row in a run shares ONE _epoch so the downstream feeder can
# first-seen dedup via eventstats min(_epoch) by repo_full_name.

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())
snapshot_date = now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'repo_full_name', 'owner', 'name', 'html_url', 'description',
    'language', 'stars_total', 'stars_today', 'source',
    'snapshot_date', '_epoch',
]

HEADERS = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 SpeakesQuery-Ingest', 'Accept': 'text/html'}
TRENDING_URLS = [
    'https://github.com/trending',
    'https://github.com/trending?since=weekly',
]

rows = []
seen = set()
for ui in range(len(TRENDING_URLS)):
    url = TRENDING_URLS[ui]
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=30)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.text
    except Exception:
        continue
    if not body:
        continue
    try:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(body, 'html.parser')
        articles = soup.find_all('article', class_='Box-row')
    except Exception:
        continue
    for ai in range(len(articles)):
        art = articles[ai]
        h2 = art.find('h2')
        link = h2.find('a') if h2 else None
        href = (link.get('href', '') if link else '') or ''
        full = href.strip('/')
        if not full or full.count('/') != 1:
            continue
        if full in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(full)
        parts = full.split('/')
        owner = parts[0]
        name = parts[1]
        ptag = art.find('p')
        desc = ' '.join(ptag.text.split()) if ptag and ptag.text else ''
        if len(desc) > 300:
            desc = desc[0:300]
        langtag = art.find('span', attrs={'itemprop': 'programmingLanguage'})
        language = langtag.text.strip() if langtag and langtag.text else ''
        stars_total = 0
        alinks = art.find_all('a')
        for li in range(len(alinks)):
            lk = alinks[li]
            lhref = lk.get('href', '') or ''
            if lhref.endswith('/stargazers'):
                digits = re.sub(r'[^0-9]', '', lk.text or '')
                stars_total = int(digits) if digits else 0
                break
        stars_today = 0
        spans = art.find_all('span')
        for si in range(len(spans)):
            stext = spans[si].text or ''
            if 'stars today' in stext or 'stars this week' in stext:
                digits2 = re.sub(r'[^0-9]', '', stext.split('star')[0])
                stars_today = int(digits2) if digits2 else 0
                break
        rows.append({
            'repo_full_name': full,
            'owner': owner,
            'name': name,
            'html_url': 'https://github.com/' + full,
            'description': desc,
            'language': language,
            'stars_total': stars_total,
            'stars_today': stars_today,
            'source': 'trending',
            'snapshot_date': snapshot_date,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

# Hybrid fallback -- only when scraping clearly failed (markup change).
if len(rows) < 5:
    cutoff = datetime.fromtimestamp(now_epoch - 30 * 86400, timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    items = []
    try:
        fr = requests.get(
            'https://api.github.com/search/repositories',
            params={'q': 'created:>=' + cutoff, 'sort': 'stars',
                    'order': 'desc', 'per_page': 30},
            headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json',
                     'User-Agent': 'SpeakesQuery-Ingest'},
            timeout=30,
        )
        fr.raise_for_status()
        items = fr.json().get('items', [])
    except Exception:
        items = []
    for ii in range(len(items)):
        it = items[ii]
        full = it.get('full_name', '') or ''
        if not full or full in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(full)
        fparts = full.split('/')
        fowner = fparts[0] if len(fparts) > 0 else ''
        fname = fparts[1] if len(fparts) > 1 else ''
        fdesc = it.get('description', '') or ''
        if len(fdesc) > 300:
            fdesc = fdesc[0:300]
        fstars = int(it.get('stargazers_count', 0) or 0)
        rows.append({
            'repo_full_name': full,
            'owner': fowner,
            'name': fname,
            'html_url': it.get('html_url', '') or ('https://github.com/' + full),
            'description': fdesc,
            'language': it.get('language', '') or '',
            'stars_total': fstars,
            'stars_today': fstars,
            'source': 'search_api',
            'snapshot_date': snapshot_date,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.sort_values('stars_today', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
